sentences.text: The dechlorinated refill bucket sits under the sink, labeled in Sharpie so no substitute teacher pours straight tap water again. Between setups, the driver — a retired REME mechanic — explained the clutch to three fascinated extras. Each armored prop carries a fire extinguisher bolted inside the hull, hidden from every camera angle. "He's not dead, he's sleeping," Tomas announced, though Ms. Reyes quietly moved the net closer just in case. The prop master wiped diesel off the Sherman's glacis plate before the lens got anywhere near it. Per the laminated rota taped beside the aquarium, Thursday feeding duties belong to Table Four, not to whoever arrives first.
